svg.text: Agent Designer Topology: Three Enterprise Workflows & Cross-Source RAG
No Cloud Run Required | Scoped 1P DataStores per Node | Sequential Multi-Step Execution & Non-GWS Canvas Export
Scenario 1: Cosmetic Ad-Copy Compliance Pre-Review (Sequential Workflow)
Scenario 2: Brand & Channel Sales / Inventory Risk Briefing (Low-Code Agent)
Scenario 3: Customer VOC & Quality Claim Escalation (Sequential + Canvas)
